paragraphs.text: This was a token of his stable faith, that for all his troubles he turned to God.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Selah here signifies a lifting up of the voice, to cause us to consider the sentence as a thing of great importance.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: When he considered the truth of God's promise, and tried the same, his faith increased marvellously.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: No matter how great or many the dangers may be, yet God always has ways to deliver his.
paragraphs.label: d
